Name: Better Junimos Forestry Redux - Alternative Textures Compatibility
Author: shamikaze284
Description:
As someone who enjoys Better Junimos Forestry Redux (and Better Junimos, of course) and Alternative Textures, I've often struggled with the save-exit-reload cycle whenever I've wanted to change the texture of my Junimo Huts in game! As others may have also encountered, the Better Junimos Forestry Redux menu prevents the Alternative Textures Paint Bucket tool from being used on Junimo Huts.

This lightweight compatibility mod resolves that conflict.

When the player is holding the Alternative Textures Paint Bucket, Better Junimos Forestry Redux steps aside and allows Alternative Textures to process the click normally.

For every other condition (using a different tool, holding something, or being empty-handed) Better Junimos Forestry Redux behaves exactly as it always has.
[line]
[size=4]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Allows the Alternative Textures Paint Bucket to work on Junimo Huts. [/*]
[*]Leaves Better Junimos Forestry Redux unchanged for all other tools. [/*]
[*]Does not modify either original mod. [/*]
[*]Does not modify any game assets. [/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Better Junimos[/*]
[*]Better Junimos Forestry Redux[/*]
[*]Alternative Textures[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*]Install all required mods.[/*]
[*]Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game.[/*]
[*]No configuration is required. [/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4]Known Limitations[/size]

Not currently supported:
[list]
[*]Paint Brush[/*]
[*]Spray Can[/*]
[/list]As the Paint Bucket is the primary Alternative Textures tool used to apply building textures, and Junimo Huts aren't generally something you have hundreds of on your farm, I feel it's perfectly reasonable to just worry about that Paint Bucket. ♥

[line]

[/list]This mod simply allows these excellent mods to work together more smoothly.

[i]If you encounter any issues or compatibility problems, please let me know on the Posts or Bugs tab. Feedback and bug reports are always appreciated.  Please do be kind; this is my very first published Stardew mod.[/i]
